description: WRITE (opt-in): save or update YOUR private note on an Oxford Ledge reading-list entry. One of TWO mutating tools here (the other is ol_paper_trade). DEFAULTS TO A DRY RUN: with _dry_run omitted or true you get a proposal {dry_run: true, tool, args, idempotency_key, message}, not a save. Re-call with _dry_run: false AND that same _idempotency_key to execute; a repeat of the same key returns {replay: true, ...} without writing twice. Requires Researcher tier AND an authenticated Oxford Ledge caller -- the local stdio server has no account context and raises AUTH_REQUIRED. `slug` must already exist on /reading-list; `body` is capped at 500 chars. Notes stay PRIVATE; this tool can never publish one. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes. Needs an Oxford Ledge API key that the client's operator configures; anonymous callers are refused.

_dry_run.description: Default true: propose without persisting. Re-call with false to execute.

_idempotency_key.description: Optional replay-safety key; auto-derived if omitted.

body.description: The note text (max 500 chars). Notes are PRIVATE; publishing requires the dashboard flow (age attestation).

name: reading_list_annotate
title: Reading List Note
